root_cause: Coordinate discovery calls check_axis once per coordinate and axis, and check_axis treats the name-regex fallback as equal evidence to CF metadata or axis-specific units. As a result, auxiliary coordinates named like latlike/lonlike are added as latitude/longitude candidates alongside the real 2D latitude/longitude coordinates, causing duplicate-axis resolution to discard the axis instead of preferring the metadata-backed coordinate.
approach: Add a keyword-only switch to check_axis that disables the regular-expression fallback. In _generate_coordinate_map, identify coordinates first with CF/units criteria only, then use the regex fallback only for axes that still have no candidate, so namelike auxiliary coordinates cannot create duplicates when a real latitude/longitude coordinate exists.
tests_to_add: Regression test based on test_coord_identification_with_other_namelike_vars if the patch budget allows; otherwise run the issue-provided test locally during patch verification.
risk_notes: The main risk is preserving legacy regex-only discovery for non-CF datasets while changing precedence when stronger coordinate evidence exists.
out_of_scope_observations: The issue text misspells auxiliary, and the existing test name test_auxilary_lat_lon_with_xy also contains that typo; no spelling cleanup is planned.
